change: Reuse the pre-propagation webs for DCE, excluding the single-definition destination whose reads moved to a different physical source register. Self-copies retain fresh analysis. Single-copy ordering and the 1024-round bound are unchanged.
measurement_source: Frozen baseline at base_commit and candidate at that base plus only this commit's machine/simplify.go change. Both already include immutable reaching sets and allocation-proposal reuse. Their earlier isolated percentages must not be added to these results.
scope: Compiler microbenchmark and compression-only native emission. No C compilation, linking, hash execution or application-runtime timing. Native object and C companion are byte-identical in all four emissions.

platform.limitations: Shared host with uncontrolled frequency and scheduling. Load recorded per run. No builds or tests from this experiment overlapped timing. Four emitter processes give two observations per variant, insufficient for a stable general wall-time multiplier or confidence interval.

microbenchmark.protocol: Before-a, after-a, after-b, before-b, each five samples of three iterations; ten samples per variant. Each iteration clones and lifts the same 128-copy body and checks exactly 128 propagated and eliminated copies.

emission.protocol: All microbenchmarks completed, then sequential before-a, after-a, after-b, before-b emissions. /usr/bin/time -l measures checking, native candidate search, fresh verification and C/object writing. CPU seconds are user plus system, potentially greater than wall time for parallel Go work. Maximum RSS is process memory, distinct from cache payload bytes.

In a fresh scratch directory run the microbenchmark command in before/after/after/before order, preserving every sample and sysctl -n vm.loadavg before and after each invocation.

Run the emitter command sequentially in the same order with distinct output prefixes, preserving stdout, stderr, time -l counters and before/after load. Disable cache and keep the normal proof budget. Do not overlap experiment builds/tests.
Compare all four .c and .o files byte-for-byte; require all eight result chunks freshly Proven with zero cached verdicts. Report CPU, wall and memory separately, including shared-host limitations.
